in_arabic.name: وسام
in_arabic.meaning: علامت، نشان، اعزازی علامت دینے والا، انعام دینے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: وسام (wassām) کا مطلب ہے علامت یا نشان دینے والا۔ یہ نام وسم (wasm) سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نشان یا داغ۔ اس نام کا روحانی مفہوم یہ ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو ان کی خوبیوں اور اعمال کی بناءً پر علامتیں یا انعامات دیتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، اس نام کا استعمال ان لوگوں کے لیے کیا گیا ہے جو اعزازی علامتیں یا انعامات دینے کے لیے جانے جاتے ہیں۔ ثقافتی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی تقلید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ انعامات اور خوبیوں کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: वसाम
in_hindi.meaning: चिह्न, निशान, सम्मानजनक चिह्न देने वाला, पुरस्कार देने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: वसाम (vasām) का अर्थ है चिह्न या निशान देने वाला। यह नाम वस्म (wasm) से व्युत्पन्न है, जिसका अर्थ है निशान या दाग। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व यह है कि अल्लाह अपने अनुयायियों को उनकी अच्छी विशेषताओं और कार्यों के आधार पर चिह्न या पुरस्कार देता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पुरस्कारों और अच्छी विशेषताओं का प्रतीक है। ऐतिहासिक रूप से, इस नाम का उपयोग उन लोगों के लिए किया गया है जो सम्मानजनक चिह्न या पुरस्कार देने के लिए जाने जाते हैं।

in_english.name: Wassam
in_english.meaning: Sign, symbol, one who gives a mark or award
in_english.long_meaning: Wassam (wassām) is derived from the Arabic root 'wasm', meaning sign, symbol, or mark. The name signifies one who gives signs or awards, reflecting the spiritual concept of Allah rewarding believers for their good deeds. Etymologically, it relates to the Quranic theme of signs and symbols in the universe. Historically, the name has been used for individuals known for giving honorary marks or awards. In Islamic tradition, Wassam symbolizes divine recognition and appreciation of good actions, embodying positive personality traits such as generosity and acknowledgment.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, the name "Wassam" is a beautiful and unique name that symbolizes the act of giving and spreading joy to others. In many Islamic cultures, the giving of gifts is a cherished tradition and an expression of kindness and love, particularly during special occasions like Eid and weddings. The name Wassam serves as a reminder of this cultural practice, and as a source of inspiration for individuals to strive to bring happiness and joy to those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Wassam carries deep meanings related to the universal concept of giving and the role it plays in personal and spiritual growth. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Give gifts to the people, and you will take their love." (Bukhari and Muslim) This statement highlights the spiritual significance of giving, which is the ability to connect with others on a deeper level and to strengthen relationships and bonds. The name Wassam serves as a reminder of the importance of this spiritual practice, and inspires individuals to continuously strive to give and receive in a way that uplifts and nourishes the soul. By embodying the name Wassam, one can aspire to become a source of blessings, joy and happiness for others, and to develop the character traits of selflessness, generosity and love.
